summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2115602515249226189))** (in Japanese) summarizes **ATAS (Any Time, Any Space)**, a world-state-centric framework for agentic video generation that separates scene and event memory, compiles scripts into shot requests, and only commits verified observations; it tops four video backbones at about 1.25x runtime.
relevance: Verified world-state memory for multi-shot agentic video consistency.
